## Story DD Coverage
- dd-5: bridge_alerts smoke test confirms operator-visible output post-stateless redesign

## Testing Mode
RED

## DISPATCH GATE (plan-review F2)
Sprint MUST verify 9e3f-3208-af65-4b34 status=closed BEFORE dispatching T3. Without 9e3f, reconcile.py's stateless form does not exist and T3 fails RED for the wrong reason (ImportError, not behavioral). Pre-dispatch check:
```bash
.claude/scripts/dso ticket show 9e3f-3208-af65-4b34 | jq -e '.status == \"closed\"' || echo 'FAIL: 9e3f-3208 still open'
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/dso_reconciler/test_bridge_alerts_surface.py
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make lint-ruff
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make format-check
- [ ] Test file exists
  Verify: test -f tests/dso_reconciler/test_bridge_alerts_surface.py
- [ ] Test drives the stateless reconcile.py orchestrator and asserts alert_store emits at least one operator-visible alert
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/dso_reconciler/test_bridge_alerts_surface.py::test_alert_emitted_through_stateless_path
- [ ] Test imports stateless reconcile module and references alert_store
  Verify: grep -qE 'from plugins.*reconcile|import.*reconcile' tests/dso_reconciler/test_bridge_alerts_surface.py && grep -q 'alert_store' tests/dso_reconciler/test_bridge_alerts_surface.py

## Implementation Notes

Drive the stateless reconcile.py orchestrator (sibling 9e3f-3208 deliverable) through a minimal scenario that triggers an alert (e.g., simulate an invariant violation or a fetcher anomaly). Assert that alert_store contains ≥1 record matching the scenario.

**Out-of-scope (plan-review F4)**: This smoke test verifies the ORCHESTRATOR-SIDE alert emission. Consumer-side surfacing (ticket-lib-api.sh display, CLAUDE.md operator-facing reference) is OUT OF SCOPE — those flows belong to a future operator-doc audit; declared explicitly here so the completion-verifier doesn't expect consumer-side assertions.

Test uses mocks/stubs for any external system (Jira, git tickets-branch) — this is unit-scoped smoke, NOT live integration.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
